correctness.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the 11-vertex triangle-free Mycielskian C5 with 20 edges. Independent full finite constructions at k=2..8 yielded disconnected generator counts (35,110,180,176,106,35,5), nonempty faces (2015,1915,1634,1124,567,171,21), and exact acyclic Morse matching counts (1002,954,809,554,275,85,10). Critical-cell counts and signed Morse matrices were reconstructed; their integer Smith nonzero invariants are k=3:(1,1,2), k=4:(1,1,1), k=5:(1,1), k=6:(1). The 3x3 signed matrix for k3 has determinant 2, hence a Moore M(Z/2,6) stage, while k4-6 attach only by unit degrees yielding sphere wedges; k7,8 contractible, k1 and k>=9 void. These are exact finite exhaustive proofs with CW attachment classification, not a pattern extrapolation.
